name: diagnosing-bugs compact v2 regression and independent repository transfer pilot
hypothesis: Application-state semantic checks repair the known v1 event-reason omission; the compact v2 may reduce usage without losing accepted public behavior on an independent repository. Observed costs can increase, and no general efficacy or non-inferiority claim is planned.

cohorts.name: regression
cohorts.role: Known fetch-lifecycle control with unchanged grader; onInsert success is checked explicitly. Not a holdout.

cohorts.name: transfer
cohorts.role: New normalize-url issue #193 task from pinned upstream pre-fix source and maintainer fix. Candidate frozen before repository selection/research.

delivery.order: adjacent original-Skill baseline / compact-v2 treatment pairs, baseline first; regression cohort then transfer cohort

environment.nativeGuard: Native session pins matrix-listed user configuration/Skills, both evaluated Skills, bench and compiled runner before/after each invocation. Inherited configuration is not isolated.
environment.rtkCheck: Additional referenced instruction checked before/after each cohort, not recursively pinned before/after every native call.

calibration.reason: Known lru-cache baseline historically saturated; transfer difficulty uncalibrated. Fixed small pilot of two pairs per task, for regression and descriptive cost observations, below significance/scale thresholds.

analysis: Analyze each cohort separately using all declared surviving pairs. Also retain all-invocation cost and final/partial/unknown coverage. Compare v1 historical failures only as development context; do not pool across versions/environments/repositories. Regrade every saved graded delivery offline. Enumerate improved/regressed checks and cost increases.
stopping: Freeze candidate, tasks, graders, compiled harness and configuration before calls. No retries, replacement samples, candidate edits or trial additions within this pilot. Execution errors or detected drift stop remaining calls in the cohort and block transfer after an incomplete regression session. Functional failures remain data and do not trigger retries. No installation recommendation from four small pairs.
reproducibility: Vendored complete inputs, frozen compiled runner/source patch, declarations, native call ledgers/receipts/transcripts and delivered workspaces. Offline replay reproduces scores/cost aggregation; fresh model reruns reproduce procedure, not identical stochastic results.
